{{Top|leg}}
'''Harod Crimmler''' was a member of the [[Historical Battleship Preservation Association]]. He was quoted by [[Imperial Defense Daily]] in an article dated 37:4:19 regarding the long and prestigious role of the metal [[Doonium/Legends|doonium]] in [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] hull construction, and how [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendel]]'s plan to get one hundred [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] by using [[Havod/Legends|havod]] alloy was an affront to the vessel's classical appearance.
